title: Haida Gwaii Glamping

services.name: Green Coast Kayaking
services.desc: Green Coast is a local company offering guided wilderness expeditions that connect our guests with the people, land, and sea of Haida Gwaii. We specialize in multi-day sea kayak trips within Gwaii Hannas National Park Reserve and Haida Heritage Site, and now offer a range of adventure services based out of Queen

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: Randy Pryce JR has been fishing for 40 years and guiding others for 6 years. He is like family to us and our favorite fishing guide to use when we are home in town on island. Alana has personally caught at least 30 fish with him throughout the years! He can be busy but will help you organize a trip with someone else
